You can get the External on our Discord:

Here are a few random pictures and videos because some people without hobbies say it's a scam, which it's not.
I'm doing this project for fun. Maybe someday I'll make it paid, but for now it's free!

If you still think it's a scam after seeing the proofs, then I can't help you. No one will force you to use our external.
